headline.text: Launch Factory v2 builds the files your team needs to review

body.text: Launch Factory v2 turns a release folder into a local package you can open in a browser. Play the captioned video, read the blog and emails, then check the animation and popup in the same review session.

The AI agent writes from the release sources. Python checks the inputs and renders the package, while FFmpeg cuts the supplied footage and burns in the captions. The command line does not call a paid model or media provider.

Each copy block cites claim IDs. The claims point to exact quotes in local files so a reviewer can check what the release supports. A matching quote confirms the source reference; a person still has to judge whether the writing preserves its meaning.

Five email variants let the team address different audiences. The campaign plan connects them with the other assets across two weeks, including written social and video posts. Dates are proposals for review. Nothing is scheduled.

A normal build requires a person to review the claims first. If the source changes, that decision becomes stale. Each build also needs a new output folder, so the earlier package stays available for comparison.
Start with the included example to inspect the output, then bring your own release notes, transcript, footage, and audience choices. Final writing and media approval remain with your team.
